resources.string: Start your dev server yourself on 127.0.0.1 or localhost, not 0.0.0.0, so it is not exposed on the server\'s network.
Open only projects you trust. The page\'s JavaScript runs on your phone, kept apart from the app\'s keys and passwords.
Do not sign in to real accounts or type real passwords, tokens or personal data into the preview page.
Check the full address before you confirm a link that leaves the preview.
The app never starts or stops your dev server, and the preview\'s data is cleared when you leave it.
